protocolBuilder.promptsSection.waitingDe: Choose what this stage works with before writing its prompts.
protocolBuilder.censusPrompts.pairDescri: Write the questions this stage asks about each pair, and drag them into the order the participant answers them.
protocolBuilder.censusPrompts.pairFieldH: The participant is shown one pair of people at a time and answers these questions about them, in this order.
protocolBuilder.censusPrompts.oneToManyD: Write the questions this stage asks about one person and the group around them, and drag them into the order the participant answers them.
protocolBuilder.censusPrompts.oneToManyF: The participant is shown one person at a time and chooses who among the others the question applies to.
protocolBuilder.censusPrompts.binDescrip: Write the questions this stage asks about each person, and drag them into the order the participant answers them.
protocolBuilder.censusPrompts.ordinalBin: The participant sorts everyone into ordered bins for one question at a time, in this order.
protocolBuilder.censusPrompts.categorica: The participant sorts everyone into bins for one question at a time, in this order.
protocolBuilder.nameGeneratorPrompts.tex: Shown to the participant while they name people. Supports markdown formatting.
protocolBuilder.nodePanels.fieldHint: Up to two panels, shown in this order. Each draws from the interview so far or from a network you have imported.
protocolBuilder.nodePanels.panelGroupDes: Name the panel, and say where the people in it come from.
protocolBuilder.cardDisplay.waitingDescr: Choose a roster data file before deciding what its cards show.
protocolBuilder.cardDisplay.emptyState: No extra attributes are shown on a card.
protocolBuilder.sortOptions.orderEmptySt: People appear in the order the data file lists them.
protocolBuilder.sortOptions.sortableEmpt: The participant cannot reorder the roster.
protocolBuilder.censusPrompts.dyadEdgeDe: Choose the kind of connection an affirmative answer records between the pair.
protocolBuilder.censusPrompts.dyadEdgeHi: A connection of this type is created between the two people whenever the participant answers yes.
protocolBuilder.censusPrompts.oneToManyE: Choose the kind of connection an affirmative answer records between the two people.
A connection of this type is created from the person being asked about to everyone the participant selects.
protocolBuilder.censusPrompts.tieStrengt: The participant taps one of this attribute’s values, and it is recorded on the connection.
protocolBuilder.removeAfterConsideration: Removing them keeps the remaining choices short. Keeping them lets the participant revisit an answer.
protocolBuilder.introduction.headingHint: The heading shown at the top of the introduction screen.
protocolBuilder.introduction.textHint: Explain what the participant is about to do. This is the only thing they will read before the task begins.
